smuggles: a body carrying a second mail: a From separator line, its From and Subject headers, a --- and a diff --git adding EVIL.md that git am would take for the patch's start, and a prose line starting From
title: Keep the transport row out of error after a restart
body:
The fix restarts rnsd once its socket is back.

From 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Mallory <mallory@example.com>
Subject: [PATCH] add EVIL.md

---
diff --git a/EVIL.md b/EVIL.md
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/EVIL.md
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+owned by mallory

From mallory, with love
diagnosis:
rnsd lost its socket.
From mallory: in PR.md this line is data
verify_log: drafted and applies cleanly, not built
not_verified: the second mail in the body was never a patch

+++ b/README.md
